evidence.computation: Hours = nominal Wh times efficiency times usable fraction divided by constant load W.
assumptions: Constant load; stated efficiency is one-way. Unmentioned factors are one; mentioned but unread factors and round-trip descriptions are refused.
Efficiency and usable depth in (0,1]; Wh/kWh and amp-hours nonnegative, voltage and load positive.
No self-discharge, voltage sag, ageing, idle load, or Peukert model.
untrusted: English recognition and decimal parsing; JSON framing.
